Hymn 246: Onward, Christian Soldiers
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Arthur S. Sullivan
Lyricist/Text Author: Sabine Baring-Gould
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 246 titled "Onward, Christian Soldiers" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Arthur S. Sullivan and the lyrics were written by Sabine Baring-Gould.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
